name: Greek Baked Beans
steps: Peel and finely dice your onion, carrot and celery. Roughly chop your tomatoes.
Heat a large ovenproof dish over a medium heat with a glug of olive oil. Add your onion, celery and carrot and cook for 10 mins until softened.
Add your dried oregano and tomato purée to the pan and cook for 2 mins. Add your chopped tomatoes and simmer for 5 mins until just starting to break down.
Drain your butter bean tins. Pour the beans into the pan along with your vegetable stock, bay leaf and cinnamon stick. Season with a little salt, then bring to a simmer.
Pop the lid on your dish and bake for 30 mins.
Remove the lid from the dish and give the mixture a stir. Pop it back in the oven without it’s lid on for 15 mins more.
Finely chop most of your mint, setting aside a few small leaves to garnish.
Remove your beans from the oven and season to taste. Add the chopped mint and stir to combine. Sprinkle with your remaining mint leaves and a little olive oil, then serve.
